description: Shell script for testing git-bundle functionality, including creating, verifying, listing, and unbundling git bundles with various options and scenarios.

methods.name: test_commit_setvar
methods.description: Creates a commit or tag and sets a variable with its object ID, supporting options for merge, tag, notick, signoff, and directory.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object ID or 'undefined-oid' if input is invalid.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command output to replace commit and tag hashes with placeholders for stable testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes output to save as 'expect' file, removing trailing 'Z'.
